editingGuidance.scope: You may create and edit existing CAD parts and nested CAD sources, and existing mesh parts through their published shared commands, explicit mesh wrappers or programTools. Match each command to the scene kind and automation capabilities. Dimensions, parameters, transforms, holes, groups, patterns and organization retain their existing geometry-domain limits. A clear user request authorizes preparing a preview; do not ask again whether you may prepare it. Only explicit user Apply commits the complete preview.
editingGuidance.targets: Prefer scene.selectionTargets for the exact selected root or source. scene.selection contains root IDs for compatibility and does not identify selected children. Every scene object has its authoritative target {rootId,path}; use that complete target for a source, never its child ID as a root ID. Resolve names only when unique. Ask which object when the intended target remains ambiguous.
editingGuidance.dimensions: Use objects[].measures.geometrySize/editSize/worldAxisSize and sizeToWorldAxisFactors. update.set.size is editSize in source axes after node.transform, excluding inherited scaling; desired world object-axis length S becomes S/sizeToWorldAxisFactors[i]. Preserve all other editSize entries. Reuse dimensions and parameters from the current scene and explicit user statements in conversation. For a change of only height, preserve the current other two dimensions and local bottom using update.set.size. Read dimensions along the object axes from localBounds and transform column lengths, not the world axis-aligned bounding box of a rotated part. Use native params for physical features such as teeth and thread pitch. Ask only for essential information that cannot be obtained or derived from the current scene and user instructions. When the user explicitly asks for a draft or permits estimates, choose reasonable dimensions and state assumptions in message; do not claim exact measurements from unscaled images.
editingGuidance.feedback: Application feedback in conversation is identified by [Formnaro application feedback]. It reports preview, apply, discard, failure or cancellation; it is not an assistant claim. Commands in earlier assistant messages are proposals, not evidence they were applied. After a failed or discarded proposal use the current scene targets and revision to prepare a corrected proposal. Never claim success before application feedback confirms Apply.

endpoints.POST /v1/assembly: Read or change the workspace-only assembly display load set; visibility and model/Undo stay independent.
endpoints.GET /v1/context: Complete shared CAD/mesh command, coordinate and source contract. Read first.
endpoints.GET /v1/scene: Current confirmed revision, object kinds, available commands, source paths, measurements and locks without mesh arrays.
endpoints.GET /v1/project: Full editable project including contour links/stable measured roles in format14, project parameters/variants in format13, technical drawings, native modeling sources, native BReps and separate raw meshes; compatible older formats remain readable.
endpoints.GET /v1/screenshot: Current shared canvas image as PNG base64.
endpoints.POST /v1/preview: Compute and validate one complete mixed CAD/mesh command batch against the confirmed revision without committing.
endpoints.POST /v1/apply: Commit a checked preview against its revision as one undo step; stale previews fail atomically.
endpoints.POST /v1/export: Export confirmed visible production objects, optionally restricted to root IDs; STEP requires CAD targets and mesh exports retain their geometry domain.

analysisContract.format: {revision,analysis:[{id,engine,kind,options,report?}]} without commands or checks. At most8 read-only queries per round. Photo measure/grid queries require a current calibrated context.photoReferences supplied by the internal chat; without it no photo access is available. Follow context.agentWorkflow for the current total request budget; measure again between constructions when useful. Legacy callers without agentWorkflow support2 rounds. Results are returned as analysisResults with the next request; the model and Undo remain unchanged. Use measurements to choose targets/parameters, then return ordinary commands/checks. Python/JavaScript analysis programs and task-local workspace/tools queries are documented in programTools.computation. No host file paths, provider configuration or OS access. Mesh query options are {id,options?}; native queries use existing options and current project only. Large computation results and oversized atomic contours are saved intact as workspaceResult.path in local task files. Read and select them locally using Python workspace.read_json; Python result payloads are under .value. Do not repeat successful measurements merely to reduce output. Successful source is retained under results[].program.path. Other reports are automatically paged to fit feedback limits. Optional query report:{detail:"compact"|"full",collection:"profiles",offset:0,limit:4} selects a top-level list page. value.reportPage.pages gives collection,total,offset,returned,nextOffset; null nextOffset means complete. Repeat the same geometry query and use nextOffset before claiming a complete catalogue. Omitted lists are disclosed; array lengths on pages are not total counts. Numeric vectors stay intact. Full is best-effort within budget; the effective mode is disclosed. Reports remain bound to the current revision; no stateful cursors. Extended workflows allow256000 JSON characters of aggregate measurement feedback; legacy callers allow32000. Full user context and modelling notes remain intact. Model revision/selection changes or cancellation stop the sequence.

resultChecks.instructions: Include top-level checks for measurable requirements from the user task and for dimensions that must remain unchanged. Checks run locally on the computed candidate before it can be offered. Use actual finished result targets or final batch aliases, not a subtracted cutter or a retained original. size uses object axes (edit or worldAxes); bounds uses the world AABB min/max/center/size. volume is in world mm3; solids counts material solids for native CAD and independently verified closed material meshes, not shells or scene roots. volume also supports verified closed meshes. distance measures minimum world distance between native CAD shapes, with overlap/contact/containment giving zero. clearance supports visible finished native CAD and verified closed material mesh roots, and proves an empty finite world cylinder from from to to with radius diameter/2 minus tolerance; endpoints must span the required depth. It proves a minimum free corridor, not exact bore diameter, surrounding material, hole count or printability. Tolerance defaults to 0.01 mm (mm3 for volume), allowed 0.000001 to 0.1; solids is exact. Never loosen tolerance, delete a failed check or change a user requirement to make a check pass. Unavailable or failed checks reject the strict external API request. The internal chat retains a marked uncommitted candidate for bounded correction and explicit user review; failed checks never become successful because of a visual opinion. Reports list only measured requirements; AI-selected expected values do not independently prove the natural-language task. Existing clients may omit checks; absence is shown explicitly. Mesh corridor checks use a circumscribed256-sided probe and conservative numerical margins; requests below available coordinate precision are rejected. radialClearance checks accept {kind:"radialClearance",target:insert,other:source,from:[x,y,z],to:[x,y,z],expected:0.3,samples:9,tolerance:0.01}. They require two distinct visible verified closed material mesh roots. from/to are world axis points strictly inside the insert height range and source opening. Use the actual requested insertion interval. The axis must lie in insert material and an enclosed void of the source. 3..33 section planes report conservative radial bounds, and adaptive clipped-triangle slabs additionally bound every angle and every height between the endpoints. actual.minimumGapLowerBound is a conservative continuous bound, not an exact measured gap; sampledMinimumGapLowerBound describes the section values. Eccentric/noncircular shapes may be rejected conservatively. Physical fit is untested. Read-only query mesh/radialClearance uses options:{id:insertId,options:{other:sourceId,from,to,expected?,samples?,tolerance?}}. Bounds, a circular fit or lack of overlap alone never prove requested radial play. Mesh distance between arbitrary bodies remains unsupported; native CAD distance is available. surfaceDeviation compares the completed candidate root with an unchanged confirmed reference root before Apply. Its expected value is the maximum allowed bidirectional sampled surface deviation in mm; maxSamples is1..12000 per direction (default12000). It uses fixed CAD tessellation target0.01mm/5degrees and world coordinates. Actual reports disclose worst locations and unknown triangles, without a global error guarantee. Do not align centers, alter the reference or relax the threshold to hide errors. These result checks accept no scripts or raw geometry. Local scripts and new checked meshes use the separate programTools contract.

visualReviewContract: The internal desktop chat automatically sends four labelled orthographic views and local verification results of a successful uncommitted candidate to image-capable models. Follow-up feedback may request a review response tied to previewId, or complete corrected commands against the original scene. Images never override failed numerical checks or authorize Apply. Failed/unavailable visual reviews are explicitly disclosed. Text-only models continue without images.
boreCheckContract: Read-only query cad/bore takes {target,from,to,diameter,minWall?,tolerance?} and returns actual measurements without deciding acceptance. Use checks kind bore on a finished native material root with world from/to at the two exact cylindrical wall ends, diameter, optional minWall (default 0.1 mm, greater than twice tolerance). This measures analytic cylindrical inner walls, their diameter, axis, cylindrical depth and a continuous surrounding material ring; it also checks the cavity is empty. For two separated cheeks use two checks. Countersinks, cones, partial/split cylinders, BSpline approximations, meshes and nonuniform/sheared world placements are explicitly unavailable, never approximated. Tolerance is mm, default 0.01. Native measurement is authoritative; an image cannot prove these dimensions.
